facts: Pinned SmolLM3 original and initial retained frequency context use configured max_position_embeddings, independently of nested original context metadata.

Shared public dynamic frequency decorator receives maximum position plus one. Growth can update retained frequency context; a short call below configured context can reset it. Equality with configured context after growth does not itself reset.
Static inspection: SmolLM3 rotates newly computed keys on enabled layers before handing them to its cache update interface.
Static inspection: ordinary non-sliding DynamicLayer concatenates incoming key/value state; no previous-key rephasing is specified at that boundary. No cache implementation executed.
Generic partial-factor initializer outputs do not qualify the SmolLM3 full-head rotary consumer for partial widths.
NoPE flags select whether a layer rotates Q/K; no inference about other families or cache types.
